comments.content: [medium] Conversion failures are silently ignored in these functions: `std::strtol` and `std::strtof` can fail without raising any signal. Consider validating the outcome by checking errno or the end pointer to confirm the conversion actually succeeded.
[medium] `mapCcxToVtk[type]` is looked up repeatedly inside the loop, which is wasteful. Consider caching a reference to the vector before entering the loop.
[medium] This hand-written loop could be replaced with the STL algorithm `std::find_if`, which would be more idiomatic and arguably easier to read.
[medium] `dataSetName` is extracted but never checked. Before using it as the array name, consider validating that it is not empty and does not consist solely of whitespace.

[medium] In the `code2` branch, `countScaPos` is never advanced while the additional values are consumed, so scalar/vector classification is incorrect for multi-line node records — every value from a continuation line ends up at the same position, and the arrays get mis-populated.

Fix: advance `countScaPos` while iterating over `sub` (for instance `for (...; ...; it += 12, ++countScaPos)`), matching how the `code1` logic does it.
[low] A short comment describing the intended invariant for `std::find_if` could prevent accidental drift.
[low] Consider naming the policy used by `nodes` so nearby call sites do not duplicate it differently.
